milestones.title: Engineering and knowledge transfer
milestones.description: Reliable continuous development, issue/spec/PR evidence, periodic engineering probes, and owner learning portal.

milestones.title: v0.1 Numerical baseline
milestones.description: Deterministic numerical core, analytical tests, reproducible CLI artifacts and existing baseline estimators.

milestones.title: v0.1b Sensor realism and robustness
milestones.description: True versus assumed noise, controlled constant/linear sensor offsets, and prespecified held-out constant-bias robustness experiments.

milestones.title: v0.2 Interactive local demo
milestones.description: Local bounded experiment service, browser visualization, controls and inspectable recorded results.

milestones.title: v0.3 Unreliable delivery and replay
milestones.description: Explicit sample/arrival time, delay/loss, bounded queues, stale-data policy and reproducible replay research.

milestones.title: v0.4 Richer estimation
milestones.description: Heading and physical sensor models, bias-state estimation and EKF evaluated on established failure cases.

milestones.title: Exploratory research candidates
milestones.description: Optional local learned-correction/inference ideas beyond the committed initial implementation scope; require a defined question before dispatch.
